claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the PlayStation 5 logo on the white console.
The report does not state whether the console is the original fat model or the slim model.
Photos cannot show the country of origin or usage history.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show one white game controller in front of the console.
The report describes the console's appearance but not its wear history or close-up condition.
Exterior photos cannot prove whether the console has been opened or repaired internally.
Photos cannot show thermal performance or whether the console overheats in use.
Photos cannot demonstrate that any port functions correctly.
The report shows only one controller, not multiple pads.
No receipt is visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or is otherwise non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the console turning on, booting to the home screen, and shutting down normally.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working console for parts or repair.

risks.risk: Disc drive does not read discs if it is a disc model.
risks.proof: Clip of a disc being inserted, recognized, and a game launching.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a digital-only console or with a faulty drive.

risks.risk: Model variant and storage capacity are unknown (fat vs slim, disc vs digital, storage size).
risks.proof: Photo of the model and serial label on the rear or bottom, or a screenshot of system storage settings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest-value variant consistent with the photos.

risks.risk: Power cable, HDMI cable, and original box are missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included cables and the original box.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console and controller only, with no accessories or packaging.

risks.risk: Controller battery, buttons, or connectivity are faulty.
risks.proof: Close-up of the controller and a clip of it pairing, charging, and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working controller or controller requiring battery replacement.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports and a clip of each port being used successfully.

risks.risk: Console has been opened, repaired, or overheats in use.
risks.proof: Video of extended gameplay with temperature check, plus photos of the interior if opened.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a unit with unknown repair or thermal history.

proof_requests: Photo of the model and serial label on the rear or bottom of the console.
Video of the console powering on, reading a disc, and navigating the menu.
Photo showing the power cable, HDMI cable, and original box if included.
Close-up video of the controller pairing, charging, and all buttons working.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Sony PlayStation 5 and one controller, so a worst-case price is possible without further proof. Seller claims about condition, origin, accessories, and functionality are not supported by the report.
